title: DEXF Pilot Project
content:
DEXF will be the pilot project for GitHub. Th pilot project will be done in several steps:

  1. Migrate first repository to GitHub
  2. Connect Github with AWS. Adapt builds in AWS for the first repository to pull code from GitHub.
  3. Store build artefacts in GitHub Artifacts.
  4. Repeat for each of the repositories one at the time.
  5. Investigate how to migrate builds from AWS to GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps Pipelines.
  6. Start collecting 


There are sub pages to this that documents findings in different steps and how to:s for the different parts.

DevOps team will assist during the entire migration and how to collect
